limitations: No parity classification, inventory regeneration, global drop-in, all-overload/option, or enclosing-type promotion follows from this finite evidence map.
Native Linux, current release driver, complete unchanged application after this integration, publication and comparative performance/2x/fastest acceptance remain unverified here.
Historical release4d and current development db2/7298 receipts remain separate; development packed verification is not release or speed acceptance.
Only standalone contexts are covered; attached page.request/context.request are outside this slice.
Runner defaults support the tested overlap; inherited extraHTTPHeaders/httpCredentials/proxy/clientCertificates remain outside this slice. Grouping/HAR explicitly reject.
Prototype and own undefined projection cases cover listed defaults only. Original scope-switch timeout behavior is not independently distinguished by its immediate-response ownership probe.
Runtime multipart, headersArray, additional HTTP verbs and unlisted context/request options are not established by type declarations or these fixtures.
Retry controls deliberately fail first attempt; failure and setup-timeout controls deliberately exit1. Ordinary14-case suites have no retries/skips/flakes.
Original raw traces/logs/manifests remain private; this public checkpoint exposes only neutral outcomes, fixture-relative paths and cryptographic identities.
